intent: Closed-loop in-place walking cycle with two alternating half-steps; pelvis bob/sway and the upper body/arms change direction in rhythm with the steps.

phases.description: Opens the first stride; the upper body progresses toward the first rotation extreme.
Retracts the first leg / mid-transition; the right knee reaches its strongest flexion around f16, and the pelvis rises.
Opens the opposite stride; the upper body reverses direction toward the opposite rotation extreme.
Retracts the opposite leg; the left knee reaches its strongest flexion around f36 and closes back toward the loop pose.

weightTransfer.description: The pelvis moves cyclically from left (f0) to right (X extreme at f10), then returns left (X extreme at f40); at the same time, it bobs to its highest point around f23 and its lowest point around f35. No specific support leg is assigned.

bodyMechanics.description: The legs alternate to create two stride extremes around f11 and f30. The upper body/shoulders change direction between the two half-cycles (extremes around f9 and f29-f32), with the hands changing cross-body position correspondingly; pelvis sway/bob continues throughout.

warnings: animation.json does not contain contact flags or joint world-position/ground-contact data; preview.gif uses a front view. Therefore, no specific support leg is assigned in weightTransfer.
